reviews.title: 120mm Fans Perfect for Case Airflow
reviews.comment: Very quiet and smooth running fans.  Running at full speed, you only really hear the sound of the air as it spins so no real noise or whine from the fan motors when on.  Each one also comes installed with a rubber pad around the mounting holes to take up any vibrations they may have in use. Each comes with an extension on the cable so you can daisy chain multiple ones together if you're limited on fan ports for your motherboard.  Each fan also comes with around one foot of cable in length so you should try to plan your cable management and placement ahead of time. Comes with a bag of screws to mount in the usual 120mm fan spots for a case either in the front to pull air in, on the back as an exhaust, or on the top/bottom as additional intake/exhaust fans and can move a decent amount of air.  RPM is a little on the lower side but it can still keep up with other fans of similar size going at 1600-1700 RPM. Lastly the build on these is fantastic.  Sturdy plastic frames which when twisted barely even flex so even though these may not be used in a structural sense, you can trust that they're at least durable and should last you for some time.
reviews.author: Jessie

reviews.title: Great Kit!
reviews.comment: I used these in a friends AM4 build and we were really surprised with how well they worked. They are pretty quiet and seem to push just as much air as the cooler master fans that came with the case. They also came with the mounting screws which most fans dont seem to come with. We've been using them for a while now and they've held  up well and haven't gotten any louder or slowed down. For only $17 these are a great value and should work well to keep your PC cool.
reviews.author: heartoD
